sources.title: Specs of YiHi SX300 30W Yihiecigar
sources.limitations: A contemporary SX300 specification sheet mirrored by Global Sources gives minimum, typical, and maximum input voltage and explicitly identifies one 3.7 V lithium-ion cell. It also lists 7-30 W output, 4.0-8.5 V output, 10 A maximum output current, 0.5-3.0 ohm resistance, and 92% typical efficiency.
